summary: The statement and proof are mathematically correct. All sixteen actual integer fibers and their multiplicities are accounted for, giving the asserted mass formula and total weight. The triangle projection formulas and inequality (6) are valid in both parameter ranges, including repeated vertex projection values, zero normalized shift, and threshold endpoints. The homothety in (8), both completed-square identities, and the stated rational margins check exactly. The pointwise inequality used for the nested body L is valid at both threshold boundaries and, together with L being contained in T, gives (11) with the required direction. Combining (10) and (11) proves the claimed bound for every centroid-threshold cap. The sum of the three prescribed affine functions then guarantees an original threshold below its centroid value, and monotonicity yields the asserted original-cap and strict W < 9 eta conclusions without additional assumptions.
